VAT) Get Yoast SEO Premium » Reviews from real users Rated 4.6 stars by 819 users 4.6 / 5 (opens in a new tab) Carolyn Shelby and Alex Moss had plenty to get through in the November edition of the SEO Update by Yoast . AI companies finally agreed on something, security patches are arriving faster than ever, and AI agents can now do your shopping. Here are the stories that stood out and what we’d do about them. Want the full conversation? Watch it on YouTube . Key stories from November 2026 Google, Microsoft and OpenAI agree on a shared AI training opt-out Google, Microsoft and OpenAI plan to honor one robots.txt line that tells all three whether they can train on your content. Right now, you need separate rules for each crawler. Nobody supports it yet, and Google is aiming for 2027. Why it matters: It’s rare to see these companies agree on anything, so this bit of standardization is welcome. Keep in mind that blocking training doesn’t stop AI tools from fetching and citing your pages in live answers. As Carolyn pointed out, facts can’t be copyrighted. If the same information exists elsewhere, AI will get it anyway, so you might as well be the source that gets the credit. Actionable takeaway: Leave your robots.txt alone for now. We’ll let you know when support goes live. Think about whether opting out of training actually helps your business. Put your effort into original research.
